name: Raschke Holy Grail pullback
author: Linda Raschke / EdgeLab transcription
entry_long: Established close above EMA(20); setup low touches EMA; place buy stop at setup high for next bar only
entry_short: Mirror short: established close below EMA; setup high touches EMA; sell stop at setup low
exit: 20-bar swing high/low objective or time exit at close of bar 10
stop_loss: Setup bar low for long / high for short
